question: Give me an FAA-approved Matrice 30T lost-link checklist.
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance: If a loss-of-link hazard occurs, try to reestablish the control link and, if it cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link; if the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, follow pre-determined procedures for loss of VLOS and may need to land, hover, or use a return-to-home sequence; two or more certificated remote pilots may transfer control only if both can maintain VLOS without loss of control.

claims.text: If a loss-of-link hazard occurs, the guidance states 'Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft,' and if the connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.
conditions: If the connection cannot be reestablished

claims.text: If the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.
claims.quote: If the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.

claims.text: The remote PIC may need to land immediately, enter hover mode, or employ a return-to-home sequence.
claims.quote: the remote PIC may need to land the small unmanned aircraft immediately, enter hover mode, or employ a return-to-home sequence.
conditions: Immediate action may be required by the remote PIC

claims.text: Two or more certificated remote pilots transferring operational control may do so only if they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control.
claims.quote: they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control
conditions: Two or more remote pilots transferring control

claims.text: When the remote controller signal is lost, the action of the aircraft can be set to RTH, land, or hover.
claims.quote: Loss of remote controller signal The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover
conditions: Signal Lost Action is configured in DJI Pilot 2

claims.text: When lighting is sufficient and vision systems are working normally, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the remote controller signal was lost.
claims.quote: DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the remote controller signal was lost

claims.text: When the lighting is not sufficient and the vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting is not sufficient and the vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH

claims.text: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.
claims.quote: The aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored

claims.text: The reporter states that during SAR training at 200 feet the UAS went into a lost link and returned home within 10 seconds of the glitching screen.
claims.quote: went into a lost link and returned home within 10 seconds of the glitching screen.
conditions: performing search and rescue training at 200 feet

claims.text: The report states 'Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops'.
claims.quote: Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops.

claims.text: The reporter states that in DroneSense the operator attempted to place the drone into RTH, but the RTH initiated and did not respond.
claims.quote: I attempted to place the drone into RTH without success; the RTH initiated but did not respond.
conditions: RTH command issued but not responding

claims.text: The reporter states that, per a forum post, 'Without warning the aircraft entered return to home'.
claims.quote: Without warning the aircraft entered return to home.
conditions: forum account describing a lost-link-like event

gaps.text: Claim C009 states the aircraft will remain in RTH even if RC signal is restored; FAA guidance does not confirm this persistence after restoration.
Claim C012 reports RTH initiated and not responding; C009 claims RTH persists after RC restoration.
Claim C010 reports rapid RTH during SAR at 200 ft; Claim C007 describes RTH path display under good lighting.
No verified FAA-approved Matrice 30T lost-link checklist present in supplied official docs.
No evidence of cross-section procedures for two-pilot control transfers in FAA guidance.
Unverified incident reports lack independent verification; reliability of these claims is unclear.

C001.rationale: Passage faa_ac_107_2a_2022_c0228 states to reestablish control link, and if not reestablished, start emergency/contingency procedures for loss of control link.

C002.rationale: Passage faa_ac_107_2a_2022_c0049 states that if the remote PIC cannot regain VLOS, the remote PIC or person manipulating the controls should follow pre-determined procedures for the loss of VLOS.

C003.rationale: Passage faa_ac_107_2a_2022_c0049 provides examples: the remote PIC may need to land immediately, enter hover mode, or employ a return-to-home sequence.

C004.rationale: Passage faa_ac_107_2a_2022_c0032 states two or more certificated remote pilots transferring control may do so only if both are capable of maintaining VLOS without LOC; c0033 also discusses transfer of control between pilots.

C005.rationale: Passages state that when the remote controller signal is lost, the action can be set to RTH, land, or hover in DJI Pilot 2 settings.

C007.rationale: Passage states that when lighting is sufficient and vision systems are working, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path generated before loss of signal.

C008.rationale: The cited passages state that when lighting is not sufficient and vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH.

C009.rationale: Passage states that the aircraft will remain in RTH even if the remote controller signal is restored.

C010.rationale: The cited passage states performing SAR training at 200 feet, that the UAS went into a lost link and returned home within 10 seconds of the glitching screen, with RTH at programmed altitude.

C011.rationale: The cited passage states lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops.

C012.rationale: The cited passage states the operator attempted to place the drone into RTH, the RTH initiated and did not respond, within a scenario using DroneSense.

C013.rationale: The forum passage directly quotes: 'Without warning the aircraft entered return to home' and describes a forum account of a lost-link-like event.
